title: Cash-Out Rules of the Pocketwire Personal Account
content:
**Rule.** A cash-out from a Pocketwire Personal Account can be made only while the account status is active or closure pending, or when the account was closed for risk and its fund hold period has ended. Cash-outs are available only on plans whose cash-outs are enabled; a Pocketwire Lite customer must complete identity verification and move to Pocketwire Core before any money can leave the balance.

**Limits.** The cash-outs initiated on one calendar day — the day's earlier cash-outs, Eastern Time, leaving out cash-outs later returned, plus the new cash-out — may not exceed the plan's daily cash-out limit, and an instant cash-out may not exceed the plan's maximum single instant cash-out; an amount above the instant maximum may still go by standard transfer within the daily limit. A cash-out can never exceed the ledger balance, and a cash-out that would breach a limit is declined in full with nothing booked.

**Risk-closed accounts.** The held balance of an account closed for risk is released by one standard cash-out of the whole remaining ledger balance once the plan's fund hold period in calendar days has passed since the closed date, the closed date itself not counted.

**The ledger balance.** The ledger balance is the personal-account balance built from personal-account movements — payments, bank transfers, fees, claim credits and internal transfers from other Pocketwire products. Debit card activity settles on the card's own settlement ledger, so the balance the app displays is the ledger balance together with the net of that card ledger.

### Status of the account (the rule names the complete set in which a cash-out can be made)

| Account status | Cash-out possible? |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes |
| Closure pending | Yes |
| Closed for risk, fund hold period ended | Yes — one standard cash-out of the whole remaining ledger balance |
| Closed for risk, fund hold period not yet ended | No |
| Limited or locked | No |

### Quantities, restated

- The remaining daily capacity is the daily cash-out limit less the day's cash-outs, never below 0.00.
- A cash-out is allowed when its amount is at or below both the remaining daily capacity and the ledger balance.

### Worked example (hypothetical figures)

An active account on a plan with a daily cash-out limit of 15000.00 and a maximum single instant cash-out of 10000.00 holds a ledger balance of 14000.00 and has made no cash-out today.

| Requested cash-out | Result |
|---|---|
| 12000.00 instant | Declined in full — above the instant maximum |
| 12000.00 standard | Allowed — within the daily limit and the ledger balance |
| 14500.00 standard | Declined in full — above the ledger balance |
